def create_wide_rectangle_config(width, height):

    circles = np.zeros((21, 3))
    
    # For very wide rectangles, arrange circles in horizontal strips
    num_rows = 3
    num_cols = 7  # 3 rows x 7 columns = 21 circles
    
    # Calculate spacing

    col_width = width / num_cols

            # Place in grid pattern with some randomness

            y = (i + 0.5) * row_height + np.random.uniform(-row_height*0.1, row_height*0.1)

            y = np.clip(y, 0.001, height - 0.001)
            
            # Set radius based on available space
            r = min(col_width, row_height) * 0.35
            circles[i * num_cols + j] = [x, y, r]
    
    return circles
